policy.canonicalSource: one source per tool and host; shadowed duplicates removed
policy.path: per-user bin dirs only (~/.cargo/bin, ~/.bun/bin, ~/.local/bin); PATH and profiles are owned by aphrody-claude user/shell, never edited here
policy.cargo: no Cargo build: toolchains via rustup, tools via cargo-binstall with compile strategy disabled

aphrodyArtifacts.note: aphrody-ovh is a library compiled into aphrody-infra; aphrody-ops and aphrody-workspace are Bun scripts under packages/infra/workspace and need a source checkout
aphrodyArtifacts.windowsBuild: scripts/build/rust/cargo-serial.sh build --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc -p aphrody-infra -p aphrody-kernel (integrator only, on the factory)

perHostExceptions.wsl: Ubuntu 24.04 apt is stale: ripgrep and eza via cargo-binstall, apt copies removed; jq/gh release binaries, apt jq removed
perHostExceptions.windows: winget user scope for jq, yq, carapace, zstd, wezterm nightly, gh, uv; binstall for the Rust set plus eza and ripgrep; no native rsync/pigz/zellij/sftp
perHostExceptions.vps: jq stays apt (system scripts, minimal PATH)
perHostExceptions.dbfr: jq stays apt; no extra rust targets (12G free on /)

bunGlobalNote: wasm-pack is a bun global (prebuilt release binary downloaded by its npm package); cargo copy removed

bunHygiene.policy: newest stable Bun release at least 3 days old (bunfig minimumReleaseAge); every host applies the same rule

linux.schedule: daily 05:30 +-30m, user timer, linger enabled on vps and dbfr

steps: cache report, prune entries unused 30 days above 5 GB
frozen-lockfile dry-run in a temp copy (checkout hosts only)
